title: appointment.completed v1
description: FLAT payload (does NOT use the envelope.v1 data-nested shape) — fields are top-level, matching the real producer. Emitted when an appointment transitions to completed. TWO real producer paths fire for the same transition (appointments.ex:519-527's comment 'Best-effort immediate fan-out ... the durable delivery already happened'): (1) durable outbox — Appointments.update_with_outbox/2 (appointments.ex:771-786) stages the transition via stage_lifecycle_event/2 -> AlebrijeAgenda.Outbox.emit("appointment.completed", appt) in the SAME transaction as the status update; envelope_for/2 (outbox.ex:96-109) builds this exact flat shape, but for THIS event_type specifically it is routed by @stream_routes to "events:campaigns" (outbox.ex:73,32-40 — the campaigns NPS post-service journey is the live consumer, mod-campaigns-ex event_consumer.ex:183/244, which requires the top-level contact_id this envelope guarantees to include when non-blank); (2) best-effort direct XADD — EventPublisher.publish_appointment_completed/1 (event_publisher.ex:53-56) called right after the transaction commits (appointments.ex:527, via maybe_publish_status/3 -> case "completed" at appointments.ex:840-847), stamping event_type onto the SAME payload/1 shape (event_publisher.ex:65-73) but WITHOUT contact_id, XADD'd to the literal stream "appointment.completed" (@completed_stream, event_publisher.ex:24) — rewards-go's appointment.completed consumer and this direct stream are the ones referenced in appointments.ex:815-816's comment. Both converge through the shared AlebrijeCommon.EventBus.Producer.publish/2 (producer.ex:25) — no second envelope layer. Registered here under the producer's real event_type ('appointment.completed', 2-segment) — no schema previously existed for this event type at all (ErrNoSchema / {:error,{:no_schema,...}} fail-open, producer.ex:52-56). Precedent for the flat/optional-field pattern: appointment.noshow.v1.json (DEBT #177). DEBT-AUDIT-20260701-019-catalog-crm-agenda.

event_type.description: Canonical event_type EN-USO. Always present: outbox.ex's envelope_for/2 sets it directly (outbox.ex:97), and the direct path stamps it via Map.put (event_publisher.ex:97).

appointment_id.description: UUID of the completed appointment. Stringified (to_string(id || "")) by both producers; empty string when absent.

tenant_id.description: Tenant that owns the appointment (ADR-25). Stringified by both producers; empty string when absent.

calendar_id.description: Calendar the appointment belongs to. Stringified by both producers; empty string when absent.

contact_id.description: UUID of the CRM contact tied to the appointment. REQUIRED by the live 'events:campaigns' NPS consumer (mod-campaigns-ex event_consumer.ex:244, guarded 'when is_binary(contact_id)') and present via the outbox path when non-blank (outbox.ex:96-105 drops it entirely when blank rather than emitting an empty string). The direct EventPublisher path never sets it at all. Not in 'required' here because the direct-XADD path genuinely omits it — consumers that need it (campaigns) already only subscribe to the outbox-routed 'events:campaigns' stream, not the bare 'appointment.completed' stream this field-optional union also covers.

contact_phone.description: E.164 contact phone on the appointment. Stringified by both producers; empty string when absent.

status.description: Appointment status at emit time; 'completed' for this event.
